summary: Invesco Commercial Real Estate Finance Trust, Inc. filed a Form 8-K under Item 8.01 to disclose its monthly net asset value (NAV) as of April 30, 2026, and the resulting transaction price per share for each share class. The filing includes detailed tables of NAV components and per-share NAV by class (e.g., Class S $24.8692, Class I $24.9430). This is a routine periodic NAV update, required for the company's share repurchase program, and does not involve any corporate event such as a merger, tender offer, or restructuring. There is no board recommendation, advisor, or special situation. This filing is informational only and does not trigger any event-driven analysis.
